test_run.interpretation: 15 個固定候選版窄測試通過，證明 portable module 與 shared refund 的所列回歸；不等同 parent claim/reclaim、真實 schema、SDK/router 或 release 整合通過。

evidence: text_meal_dependency_recovery.py:438-445 requires an actual charged ledger receipt matching parent attempt, user, and parent token.
text_meal_dependency_recovery.py:657-677 repeats parent validation in the provider-start transaction before the SDK call.
test_ir001_uncharged_parent_must_not_authorize_provider passes; an uncharged synthetic parent causes no provider call and no debit.
ir_rulings.remaining: Actual parent batch claim creation must produce and preserve this authoritative receipt and ownership contract through the real schema and entry path; that integration was not implemented or exercised.

evidence: text_meal_dependency_recovery.py:552-584 recognizes only standalone claimed/no-start attempts, performs owned refund inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, changes the draft owner, and records pre_provider_refunded.

The replacement claim is committed before leaving that transaction; an old process later cannot pass the live draft owner check at lines 669-676, and its provider-start update is rolled back, so it cannot reach the SDK call.
test_ir002_expired_prestart_claim_is_safely_recoverable passes while provider-started/unknown paths remain non-refundable.
ir_rulings.remaining: This safe recovery explicitly excludes batch children. Parent batch pre-start recovery, old-owner fencing, and concurrent parent-child reclaim still require real end-to-end integration proof.

evidence: shared_ai_quota.py:96-124 checks text_meal_provider_attempts by user_id and quota_attempt_id before any refund mutation and refuses provider_started, unknown, completed, or non-empty provider_started_at.
Child provider-start is committed before the SDK call, so a later refund transaction sharing this database can observe the marker.
test_ir003_actual_shared_refund_cannot_refund_parent_after_child_start passes against the actual shared refund primitive.
ir_rulings.remaining: The actual parent batch claim/fail/reclaim path still does not honor the new marker and was not integrated or tested. It could reclaim or allocate another debit after an unknown provider start. Marker visibility/atomicity is proven only for the co-located reduced schema transaction, not the actual parent lifecycle. IR-003 therefore remains BLOCKING.

evidence: text_meal_dependency_recovery.py:516-547 identifies terminal replay before parent validation and removes only the live processing/lease requirement for that replay.
Replay still requires unchanged request, exact user and batch row, child scope/message identity, charged parent receipt, and exact child quota_owner receipt.
test_ir004_completed_child_replays_after_parent_completion passes without a second provider call or debit.
ir_rulings.remaining: Actual parent schema initializer, lifecycle values, migration compatibility, SDK/router entry wiring, and precise version preservation remain untested.

verified: real charged parent receipt is required by the portable child module
standalone pre-provider owned refund and same-transaction re-claim are fenced
shared refund refuses a parent owner after a durable child provider-start marker
terminal replay does not require a live parent lease and remains ownership-scoped
not_verified: actual parent batch claim/reclaim honoring the child provider-start marker
actual parent batch pre-start recovery and concurrent old-owner fencing
atomic marker visibility across any production connection/database/schema boundary
actual host schema and migration compatibility
actual provider SDK adapter, router, and parent lifecycle wiring

conclusion.reason: 15/15 only closes the stated module/shared-refund regressions in the reduced harness. The real parent batch claim/reclaim lifecycle, batch pre-start recovery, schema and SDK/router wiring remain absent; the scoped PASS must not replace the original FAIL or be reported as full closure.
